newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Week-long S.Africa Grindrod strike ends.
newsitem.headline: Week-long S.Africa Grindrod strike ends.

text.p: Employees at South African shipping group Grindrod Unicorn Ltd, based in the port town of Durban, have ended a week-long strike for a wage increase, the company said on Friday.

Some 100 workers from three affected divisions, Grindrod International Freight, Mitchell Cotts Maritime and King and Sons, all shipping agents, resumed work at noon (1000 GMT) on Friday, a statement said.
The statement did not give details of the settlement apart from saying that an adjustment of certain minimum rates of pay had been made and that there had been a revised overtime arrangement.
There was also an agreement to back date the increase to the original salary review date.
The company had offered to raise wages by 8.5 percent, but the South African Freight and Dock Workers' Union had demanded 13 percent across the board.
The union could not be reached for comment.
